comparison.objective: Set a boring bar in a lathe tool block with prescribed orientation and stickout; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool orientation, axial positioning, and workholding versus recessed fastener use, fine collar adjustment, and dynamic-response judgment.
comparison.success_condition: Tip must face the chuck and stickout must be 45–64 mm. Tightening, rigidity, collision, and damage rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: It tests static cutting-tool setup, not iterative adjustment of a damping curve and post-lock verification.
